dataList.name: The Nascent Dewa Lembayung
dataList.desc:
When unit ini gains [Charge], gains [ChargeRouge] instead

Encounter Start: Peroleh 1 [ChargeRouge] Potency

Turn Start: At 2+ [ChargeRouge] Potency, peroleh +([ChargeRouge] Potency x 2) [ChargeRouge] Count
dataList.flavor: A young god, but a god nonetheless.

dataList.name: Pulsating Nature
dataList.desc: Peroleh +1 [ChargeRouge] Count every time [Laceration] effect is activated in an Encounter
dataList.flavor: Why... does blood make my heart rush so excitedly?

dataList.name: The Adventure
dataList.desc:
Peroleh the following effects based on [ChargeRouge] Potency pada diri sendiri
- 1+: For every [ChargeRouge] Count, beri +2% damage and pulihkan +10% HP pada target (maks 20%, 100% respectively; dibulatkan ke bawah)
- 2+: Base Power +1 untuk setiap 2 [ChargeRouge] Potency pada diri sendiri
- 3+: Turn Start: If unit ini does not have [GourmandiseAlly], and jika unit ini has 15+ [ChargeRouge] Count, consume all [ChargeRouge] Count and gain 3 [GourmandiseAlly]
- 4+: Skill Slot +1
- 5+: Encounter Start: Peroleh 3 [GourmandiseAlly] and inflict 3 [BloodyMucusAlly] on all enemies
dataList.summary: Effect enhanced based on [ChargeRouge] Potency pada diri sendiri
dataList.flavor: With every step they take, toddling from behind their first guardians, the child learns about the world, about the department store... and themself.

dataList.name: A Helping Hand
dataList.desc: When an ally is Staggered during an Encounter, use "Grab My Hand" on the said ally (2 kali per giliran)

dataList.name: Body Out of Control
dataList.desc:
If unit ini has [GourmandiseAlly], gain the following effects:
- Heal HP setara dengan 20% of damage dealt
- Pada Penggunaan Skill, peroleh +3 [Laceration] Count
- On Hit using a Skill, gain 1 [Laceration]
dataList.flavor: Though the arms, legs, and everything else about their body feels alien to the child, the faint beating from their core will soon begin its mad pulsation.

dataList.name: Leather-sewing Nail
dataList.desc: When unit ini fails to defeat an enemy using its Attack Skills, use "I'll End It for You..." on the said enemy (sekali per giliran)
dataList.flavor: They said I needed a thick, sturdy nail to punch through leather for sewing. If that didn't work, I just need to try again...!

dataList.name: Fate Lost
dataList.desc: Lose this Encounter jika unit ini is killed
dataList.flavor: One may get lost and wander onto the wrong path, but willful defiance or deviation from the flow are forbidden by "it."

dataList.name: Le Visqueux-Abject
dataList.desc:
This unit takes damage only from Skills mainly targeting unit ini, and it takes no other damage

Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, generate [BuffetField] on the field

Turn Start: Targets within the [BuffetField] gain the following effects:
- Allies (including unit ini)
  · Heal 5% HP
  · Peroleh +4 Count [Charge]
  · Peroleh 1 [Protection]
  · If the affected ally is a "Le Rouge" unit, gain 2 [Enhancement]
  · E.G.O Skills beri +50% damage

- Enemies
  · Peroleh 3 [AttackDown]
  · Peroleh 3 [DefenseDown]
  · Peroleh 2 [BloodyMucusAlly]
dataList.flavor:
In an endless feast, the Dewa Lembayung consumes and consumes; what is devoured is then digested and excreted as a field of mucus around them.
This is the outcome of consumption, where the distinction between self and other blurs. Is this phlegmatic discharge a part of me, or is it of another? Within this boundary, all that is mine pulsates, while all that is not disintegrates.

For I am afraid of what lies outside the periphery.

dataList.name: La Fin de l'Enfance
dataList.desc:
Encounter Start: Peroleh 5 [ChargeRouge] Potency

Turn End: At 15+ [ChargeRouge] Count, equip "La Nausée" Skill
Every Turn Start: Peroleh +20 [Aggro]
dataList.flavor:
Who determines the childhood's end?

The crimson child matured throughout the adventure, shaped by their experiences and sketching their own future at the end of the journey—or so they thought. Their childhood came to a sudden halt, and so too did the adventure; it was never something they could've ended on their own terms.

Childhood's end is a sudden, violent intrusion of reality from the world outside, more a forceful notice than a promised ritual: "You're not a child anymore."
